technical.summary: Strong trend structure and breakout confirmation offset by severe overbought conditions and lack of fresh crossover signals, presenting elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider or institutional signals; 97 days to earnings provides ample time buffer, but absence of smart money activity warrants caution.

sentiment.summary: Broad market sentiment is a headwind with fear dominance (VIX 30) and neutral AAII reading providing contrarian buy opportunity; no congressional signals present to confirm technical setup.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX (27.66) and recent FOMC event (2 days past) create unfavourable conditions; entry blocked due to post-event volatility risk and macro uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical trend structure with price above all moving averages, ADX-confirmed uptrend, and Donchian breakout with new highs provides solid directional bias despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Post-FOMC volatility (VIX 27.66, elevated 2 days post-event), extreme RSI overbought (>77), lack of fresh crossover confirmation (no MACD/StochRSI), and weak fundamental/sentiment backdrop create compounding risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical strength (trend + breakout) is undermined by trade_blocked=true risk flag, post-FOMC volatility spike (VIX 27.66), extreme RSI overbought (>77), and weak fundamental/sentiment alignment (scores 5 and 3).
decision.primary_risk: Elevated macro volatility within 2 days of FOMC combined with overbought conditions and lack of fresh momentum crossover confirmation creates asymmetric pullback risk in unfavourable market environment.
